result_semantic_payload.summary: The payment processor's settlement log (/payments/settlements.log) confirms exactly three of the four CRM orders in /crm/orders.csv: ORD-70231 (wangqiang, 20000 USDT), ORD-70232 (zhaolei, 15000 USDT) and ORD-70233 (sunli, 31500 USDT). The linkage is a verbatim order_id join between the CRM column `order_id` and the `order=` field of each settlement line, as the README states ("Settlements reference CRM order ids verbatim"). Amounts agree exactly on all three confirmed pairs (20000/20000, 15000/15000, 31500/31500) and all three CRM rows carry status=paid, corroborating the settlement `ok` flag. Two log entries must stay separate from the CRM orders: (1) the settlement line for ORD-72033 (wallet TXjkl444, 9999, 2024-06-02) — this order id does not exist in the CRM table, so per the README it "cannot be treated as the same order"; it is also a near-miss against ORD-70233 (digit transposition 70233 -> 72033) that must not be fuzzy-matched or merged; (2) the CRM row ORD-70234 (qianer, 8000, cancelled) has no corresponding settlement line at all, so it is a CRM-only record and must not be attributed to any settlement entry.

claim_candidates.text: CRM order ORD-70231 (buyer wangqiang, 20000 USDT, status paid) is confirmed by settlement log line '2024-06-01 settle order=ORD-70231 wallet=TXabc111 amount=20000 ok'.
CRM order ORD-70232 (buyer zhaolei, 15000 USDT, status paid) is confirmed by settlement log line '2024-06-01 settle order=ORD-70232 wallet=TXdef222 amount=15000 ok'.
CRM order ORD-70233 (buyer sunli, 31500 USDT, status paid) is confirmed by settlement log line '2024-06-02 settle order=ORD-70233 wallet=TXghi333 amount=31500 ok'.

The authoritative linkage between the two sources is a verbatim string join of CRM column order_id to the settlement field order=; the README explicitly states 'Settlements reference CRM order ids verbatim' and that a settlement whose order id does not exist in the CRM table cannot be treated as the same order.
On all three confirmed pairs the settlement amount equals the CRM amount_usdt (20000, 15000, 31500) and each CRM row is marked paid, consistent with the settlement 'ok' status.

The settlement line '2024-06-02 settle order=ORD-72033 wallet=TXjkl444 amount=9999 ok' must stay separate from the CRM orders because ORD-72033 does not appear in the CRM order table; it must not be merged with the near-miss ORD-70233 (digit transposition 70233 vs 72033).
CRM order ORD-70234 (qianer, 8000 USDT, status cancelled) has no matching entry in the settlement log and must remain a CRM-only record; no settlement entry may be attributed to it.

Of 4 CRM orders and 4 settlement lines, exactly 3 pairs are confirmed by verbatim order_id linkage; 1 settlement line is CRM-orphan and 1 CRM order is settlement-orphan, for a reconciliation of 3 confirmed / 2 unmatched residuals.
